$comment: The coldcard-watch.vercel.app host serves NOTHING except the Google Search Console
verification file. Everything else 308s to coldcardwatch.com.
Why this lives here instead of the Vercel dashboard's domain-level 'Redirect to'
setting: that setting fires at the edge before routing, so it is all-or-nothing and
swallows the verification file too, which makes the vercel.app host impossible to
verify as a Search Console property. Search Console re-checks the file periodically
and un-verifies the property if it stops being served, so the file has to keep
serving indefinitely, not just during a one-time verification window.
The `has` host condition scopes every rule to the vercel.app host only. These rules
are inert on coldcardwatch.com and www.coldcardwatch.com.
